propositions: The byte-equivalence oracle invokes a copied _legacy_convert subprocess for 884 corpus units using live mutable _PANDOC_TO constant, eliminating the independent oracle contract and causing coupled mutations to pass undetected.

Immutable golden fixture outputs with exact generating Pandoc version and platform-keyed binary SHA-256 fingerprint replace the copied legacy subprocess, preserving all 884 real production _convert calls while eliminating 884 redundant legacy subprocesses.

Platform-agnostic single-hash schema caused all three Ubuntu CI cells to reject fixture generated on macOS arm64; fix requires stable platform/architecture key selecting the exact supported binary hash and rejecting unknown platforms.
All 884 prepared corpus units remain tested through production _convert and real pinned Pandoc in per-change CI; mutation of production format to plain now fails against independent expected outputs.

Measured local elimination of 884 subprocesses and 884 live Pandoc invocations from legacy oracle; deterministic regeneration script and fast installed-version/fingerprint drift assertions ensure fixture provenance integrity.
